About Me

With expertise in instructional design, e-learning development, and LMS administration, I create engaging, results-driven digital learning solutions that enhance organizational training and educational outcomes.

I specialize in developing interactive eLearning modules, managing learning management systems, and designing curriculum that bridges the gap between pedagogy and technology. My approach combines solid instructional design principles with creative solutions to make learning accessible, engaging, and effective.

Currently based in Kampala, Uganda, I bring both academic knowledge and practical expertise to every project, with experience working across educational institutions and corporate environments.

Academic Contributions

I'm passionate about contributing to the field of educational technology through research and presentations. Recently, I presented on "Awareness, Availability, and Utilization of Computer-Based Instructional Software Among Undergraduates in Nigeria" at the Fully Online Distance Education Symposium, University of Pretoria, South Africa (2024).

My approach to both work and life is guided by continuous learning and improvement. I believe that the best learning experiences come from understanding the unique needs of each learner and creating solutions that meet them where they are.
